mechanism_append: The exported aggregate is SubagentV2Runtime. Its constructor owns the host, one output artifact store beneath host.agentDir/artifacts/subagent-output, a definition cache and a patch-operation set. Owner state is initialized lazily from the current parent: the same session reuses it; replacing a parent that still has a resident running promise throws busy. Otherwise the previous owner is closed, retirement timers and approval broker are disposed, and resident disposal is initiated before rebinding. New state restores the registry, reconciles terminal worktrees, backfills usage, registers/downgrades saved output artifacts and finalizes owner restore before building admission/broker state. Those subordinate durable contracts remain SUB-016/027/028/031. The outer export line precedes QA's method ranges; it is not an uncovered execution engine.
